subject: Logic
title: Framing Effect
description: A quick win: understand Framing Effect.

hook.text: A surgery with a 90% survival rate sounds great. A 10% mortality rate? Suddenly you hesitate.

buildup.text: The framing effect shows that how information is presented changes how we react to it.

discovery.text: Tversky and Kahneman proved people are risk-averse with gains but risk-seeking to avoid losses.

twist.text: Politicians, advertisers, and doctors all frame choices. The frame shapes the decision—not the facts.

climax.text: To beat framing, restate the same information in the opposite frame and see if your answer changes.

punchline.text: Same facts, different frame, new answer.

quiz.question: What is the framing effect?
options: Reacting differently based on how information is presented
